title: Improving the Performance of Compressed Transformers with Post-Hoc Embedding Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2602.14635v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model compression is necessary for deployment of transformer models in resource-constrained environments. However, compression reduces the performance of transformer models on downstream tasks. Existing solutions such as Knowledge Distillation (KD) and Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) have their own limitations. KD trains the student under the teacher's supervision, but needs the teacher's training pipeline. PEFT methods such as LoRA adapt a model to a new task, but they do not recover the loss caused by compression. Our intuition is that a compressed model can be improved by aligning its token embeddings with those of a better performing reference model. We learn this alignment with a small feed-forward Alignment Adapter (AlAd) placed after the final layer of the compressed model. AlAd reads a window of neighbouring tokens, so it can use local context. AlAd is trained post-hoc, after the compressed model has been produce

translated_title: 通过事后嵌入对齐提升压缩Transformer模型的性能
translated_abstract: 模型压缩是在资源受限环境中部署Transformer模型的必要手段。然而，压缩会降低Transformer模型在下游任务上的性能。现有解决方案如知识蒸馏（KD）和参数高效微调（PEFT）各有其局限性。知识蒸馏在教师模型的监督下训练学生模型，但需要教师模型的完整训练流程。LoRA等PEFT方法可以使模型适应新任务，但它们无法恢复压缩所造成的性能损失。我们的直觉是，通过将压缩模型的词元嵌入与性能更优的参考模型的词元嵌入进行对齐，可以改进压缩后的模型。我们通过一个放置在压缩模型最后一层之后的小型前馈对齐适配器（Alignment Adapter, AlAd）来学习这种对齐。AlAd会读取相邻词元的窗口，因此能够利用局部上下文信息。AlAd是在压缩模型生成之后进行事后训练的。
tldr: 提出了一种事后训练的对齐适配器（AlAd），通过将压缩Transformer模型的词元嵌入与性能更优的参考模型对齐，并利用局部上下文信息，从而恢复压缩所导致的性能损失。
en_tdlr: Proposes a post-hoc trained Alignment Adapter (AlAd) that improves compressed transformers by aligning their token embeddings with those of a better-performing reference model, leveraging local context to recover compression-induced performance loss.
